description: Reusable workbook style vocabulary and layout presets consumed by the build/layout commands (--theme, --spec).

style_roles.title: Sheet or report title, 18pt bold
style_roles.subtitle: Scope, unit and as-of date, 11pt muted
style_roles.header: Column header row, white on accent fill
style_roles.label: Row label text
style_roles.input: User-editable input cell (always a distinct fill plus a legend)
style_roles.total: Subtotal or total row, bold with a top border

conventions: One input colour only, documented in a legend cell near the top of every input sheet.
Every calculated cell carries a formula, never a pasted value, unless the override is logged in an assumption register.
Numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned, units stated in the header rather than repeated in cells.
Never use merged cells inside a data region; centre across selection instead.
Every sheet either feeds a model, holds inputs, or reports output - name it accordingly.
